cards.ex: He had to serve time for fraud.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlik uchun qamoqda jazo o'tashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda jazo muddatini o'tkazmoq, qamoqda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The suspect is now behind bars.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi hozir panjara ortida.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda, hibsda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He got off easy with just a fine.
cards.exUz: U faqat jarima bilan yengil qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Oz jazoga loyiq bo'lish yoki jazosiz qolish.

cards.ex: The judge threw the book at him.
cards.exUz: Sudya uni eng qattiq jazoladi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun doirasida eng qattiq jazoni qo'llamoq.

cards.ex: She's always been a law-abiding citizen.
cards.exUz: U doim qonunga itoatkor fuqaro bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlarga rioya qiladigan fuqaro.

cards.ex: You can't take the law into your own hands.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zboshimchalik qila olmaysiz.
cards.term: take the law into your own hands
cards.uzDef: Qonunni chetlab o'tib, o'zi adolat o'rnatmoqchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He has to face the music for his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlari uchun javob berishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xatosi uchun javob berishga majbur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The lawyer tried to cut a deal for his client.
cards.exUz: Advokat o'z mijoziga kelishuvga erishishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybini tan olib, yengilroq jazoga kelishmoq.

cards.ex: He decided to plead guilty to the charges.
cards.exUz: U ayblovlarni tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda o'z aybini tan olib, gunohkorligini aytmoq.

cards.ex: The prosecution must prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.
cards.exUz: Prokuratura aybdorlikni asosli shubhadan tashqari isbotlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybdorlikni isbotlash uchun etarli dalil.

cards.ex: The police decided to drop the charges due to lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Politsiya dalillar yetishmasligi sababli ayblovlarni bekor qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ayblanuvchiga qarshi ayblovni olib tashlamoq.

cards.ex: The judge decided to let him off with a warning.
cards.exUz: Sudya uni ogohlantirish bilan ozod qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jazolamasdan ozod qilmoq, kechirmoq.

cards.ex: The company is currently under investigation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hozirda tergov ostida.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat yuzasidan tergov harakatlari olib borilmoqda.

cards.ex: He's on probation for two years.
cards.exUz: U ikki yil sinov muddatida.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikda, lekin sud nazorati ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves their day in court.
cards.exUz: Har kim sudga murojaat qilishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: O'z nuqtai nazarini sudda himoya qilish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: You have the right to remain silent.
cards.exUz: Siz sukut saqlash huquqiga egasiz.
cards.uzDef: So'roq paytida gapirmaslik huquqi.

cards.ex: They exploited a legal loophole to avoid taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliqdan qochish uchun qonuniy bo'shliqdan foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunda foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan kamchilik.

cards.ex: The jury is trying to reach a verdict.
cards.exUz: Hakamlar hay'ati hukmga kelishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sud hay'ati bir xulosaga kelmoq.

cards.ex: He faced a stiff penalty for his crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyati uchun og'ir jazoga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va og'ir jazo turi.

cards.ex: He was caught drinking behind the wheel.
cards.exUz: U rulda ichimlik ichayotganda ushlandi.
cards.uzDef: Mashina rulida bo'lish, haydovchilik qilish.

cards.ex: You can't get away with cheating on the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihonda aldash jazosiz qolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilgan bo'lsa ham, jazolanmasdan qutulmoq.

cards.ex: It's the police's job to uphold the law.
cards.exUz: Politsiyaning vazifasi qonunni himoya qilish.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni qo'llab-quvvatlash va amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: No one is above the law.
cards.exUz: Hech kim qonundan yuqori emas.
cards.uzDef: Qonunga bo'ysunmaslik, qonun ustidan turish.

cards.ex: We must protect our civil liberties.
cards.exUz: Biz fuqarolik erkinliklarimizni himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fuqarolarning qonun bilan kafolatlangan huquqlari.

cards.ex: Everyone has the right to legal representation.
cards.exUz: Har kim advokatlik himoyasiga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Sudda advokat yordamida himoyalanish huquqi.

cards.ex: The wrongly convicted man was a victim of a miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri hukm qilingan odam adolatsizlik qurboni bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri sud hukmi, adolatsizlik.

cards.ex: Having a criminal record can make it difficult to get a job.
cards.exUz: Sudlanganlik tarixi ish topishni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning ilgari qilgan jinoyatlari haqidagi ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: He was released on bail.
cards.exUz: U garov evaziga ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Sudgacha ozodlikda garov puli to'lab yurish.

cards.ex: Her conduct was beyond reproach.
cards.exUz: Uning xulq-atvori aybsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday aybi bo'lmagan, benuqson.

cards.ex: He turned state's evidence to get a lighter sentence.
cards.exUz: U yengilroq jazo olish uchun hukumatga guvohlik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatda ishtirok etgan shaxs, hukumatga guvohlik berib kelishuvga erishmoq.
